example_sentences_in_bangla: ব্যবসায়ে সফলতার পর সে লাল হয়ে গেছে।
লটারিতে জয়লাভ করে তারা লাল হয়ে যাবে।
example_sentences_in_english: After succeeding in business, he became extremely wealthy.
They will become very rich if they win the lottery.
note: This idiom metaphorically uses 'red' to symbolize prosperity, possibly drawing from cultural associations of red with luck and wealth in Bengali traditions.
